code_excerpt: Category changes call loadProducts even when the manufacturer placeholder is not rendered; the callback dereferences the absent element.
problem: A completed category request throws when the optional manufacturer container does not exist.
expected: Avoid unnecessary requests or safely handle the missing container while preserving the enabled selector.
actual: Actual source and shipped minified callbacks with synthetic DOM and response doubles raised TypeError for an absent container with both empty and nonempty responses. With a present container they hid it for an empty response and displayed it for a nonempty response.
customer_impact: Category changes may cause a JavaScript error when the manufacturer option is disabled; real browser and later effects are unverified.
proposed_fix: Guard the missing container and consider avoiding the lookup when no selector is configured.
regression_risks: Preserve enabled category-dependent manufacturer selection empty responses search submission multiple instances and alternative layouts.
automated_tests: Test category changes with manufacturer enabled and disabled and empty and populated responses using the delivered asset.
manual_tests: Verify category-only and category-plus-manufacturer searches with disposable products in isolated Joomla 5 and 6.

title: Investigate missed sample reminders after their scheduled day
evidence_state: Actual reminder methods tested with synthetic dates and mail and database doubles; Joomla cron and delivery unverified
code_excerpt: Second and third reminders return unless the current date equals the calculated date.
problem: Unsent reminders are not attempted on later dates in these methods.
expected: Confirm the intended catch-up policy and avoid silently losing eligible reminders after an unavailable or failed scheduled run.
actual: The actual second reminder attempted a stubbed failed send on its due date but did not retry the following day; the actual third reminder also returned without a mail attempt on the following day. No real mail or database was used.
customer_impact: Reminders can remain unsent after a missed day or failed delivery if no other process retries them; real scheduling is unverified.
proposed_fix: Investigate overdue handling and bounded retry policy while preserving sent-state and coupon behavior.
regression_risks: Avoid duplicate reminders and unintended coupon creation and preserve already-sent state and time-zone policy.
automated_tests: Test before on and after the due day; simulated mail failure and recovery; sent-state and coupon cases; both reminder methods.
manual_tests: Verify missed daily gate and mail failure scenarios with disposable sample requests and an isolated mail sink on Joomla 5 and 6.
joomla_5_6: Synthetic date and mail/database doubles only; real cron and delivery unverified.

title: Order-list end-date filter includes next midnight and miscalculates daylight-saving days
evidence_state: Historical actual model with stubs; current source and equivalent PHP date arithmetic rechecked; Joomla and SQL unverified
